## What Karol Digital is

Karol Digital is a London-based studio that designs and engineers 100% custom websites (typically Next.js) for growing UK service businesses. Work focuses on speed, trust, clear messaging, and qualified enquiries — not template builders.

Typical website projects take 3–6 weeks. Website packages start at £95 for a performance audit. Custom builds typically range from £1,250 to £6,000 depending on scope. Quotes are fixed before a build starts. Clients own the code.

## GEO (generative engine optimisation)

GEO is the practice of structuring a website, schema, and content so AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar tools) can understand, cite, and recommend a business accurately. Karol Digital implements JSON-LD, answer-ready copy, llms.txt, service and industry entities, interactive lead magnets, and analytics.
